name: get_junos_config
description: Retrieve current Junos configuration from a device in text, set, or JSON format. Optionally filter to a specific configuration path.

device.description: Device hostname or identifier from inventory

config_path.description: Optional configuration hierarchy path to filter (e.g., 'security policies')

max_lines.description: Cap output to at most N lines

max_bytes.description: Hard byte cap on returned output

name: junos_config_diff
description: Show difference between candidate and running configuration for a device.

device.description: Device hostname or identifier from inventory

name: create_junos_change_set
description: Create a change set (plan) for multi-action configuration changes. Requires approval before application.

expected_fingerprint.description: Expected device fingerprint before applying. Application is rejected if device state changes after planning.

actions.description: List of configuration actions to stage

text.description: Configuration text in set or text format

name: approve_junos_change_set
description: Approve a change set. Must be called by a different principal than the creator (two-person control).

device.description: Device name. Required because change sets are indexed by (id, device).

expected_digest.description: Expected plan digest. Approver must confirm it matches what they reviewed.

name: apply_junos_change_set
description: Apply an approved change set to the device. Commits configuration changes to running config.

expected_digest.description: Expected plan digest. Prevents applying a plan tampered with after approval.

expected_fingerprint.description: Expected device fingerprint at apply time. Apply is rejected if device changed after plan was created.

confirm_timeout_mins.description: Optional confirmed-commit window in whole minutes. Device schedules automatic rollback unless confirmed.

name: rollback_config
description: Rollback to a previous configuration version.

device.description: Device hostname or identifier from inventory

rollback_id.description: Rollback identifier (0-49, where 0 is previous, 1 is before that, etc.)

name: get_panos_config
description: Read running or candidate PAN-OS configuration under /config. Returns XML configuration data.

source.description: Running or candidate configuration; defaults to running

xpath.description: Optional XPath rooted at /config; defaults to /config

max_bytes.description: Optional returned-content cap; defaults to 524288 and cannot exceed 5242880

max_lines.description: Optional returned-line cap; defaults to 10000 and cannot exceed 100000

name: diff_panos_candidate
description: Show difference between candidate and running configuration. Returns XML diff.

name: create_panos_change_set
description: Create a change set (plan) for multi-action PAN-OS configuration changes. Requires approval before application.

expected_candidate_fingerprint.description: Candidate fingerprint to which this plan is bound

actions.description: Ordered actions; all covered by one digest and approval

xpath.description: Exact XPath within both inventory and token policy

element.description: One XML element; required for set and forbidden for delete

name: approve_panos_change_set
description: Approve a PAN-OS change set. Must be called by a different principal than creator (two-person control).

device.description: Device name. Required because change sets are indexed by (id, device).

expected_digest.description: Expected plan digest. Approver must confirm it matches what they reviewed.

name: apply_panos_change_set
description: Apply an approved PAN-OS change set to the device. Commits configuration changes.

expected_digest.description: Expected plan digest. Prevents applying tampered plan.

expected_candidate_fingerprint.description: Expected candidate fingerprint at apply time. Rejected if candidate changed.
